items.name: minima
items.title: Minima
items.author: Enric Trillo
items.description: A neutral-dominant design system. Neutral carries structure; colour is spent only on state, identity and data.

items.name: minima-theme
items.title: Minima Theme
items.description: Thirteen OKLCH ramps of twelve steps on Radix step semantics, a canvas/surface pair, three density modes, and a semantic layer where every token resolves to a ramp step.

items.name: status
items.title: Status
items.description: Status pill and dot. The canonical carrier of the state colour job.

items.name: note
items.title: Note
items.description: A bordered callout that defaults to neutral and escalates to a state tone only when the message reports state.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard key. Always neutral — a shortcut is not a state.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: A single metric. Mono tabular value, with the delta as the only coloured element.

items.name: code
items.title: Code
items.description: Inline code and code blocks. Always mono, never coloured — syntax highlighting is a product concern.
